events.description: CIA Senior Executive Intelligence Brief warns that Bin Ladin-linked operatives are planning high-profile attacks expected to have dramatic consequences.
CIA Senior Executive Intelligence Brief warns that operatives linked to Bin Ladin's organization are planning high-profile attacks with dramatic consequences and major casualties in the near term.
The brief identifies the Arabian Peninsula as a likely venue for an anti-US attack, with a possible attack in Europe also noted.
